verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any Deel rule engine or workflow builder that lets a user define event-triggered actions. Deel Webhooks only send real-time event notifications to an external consumer. That is a developer building block for building automation elsewhere, not in-product rules that trigger actions. The MCP tools are on-demand operations an agent invokes, not event-driven rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
